model_annotation: This plot illustrates the training curves of several model variants, with the title partially visible as "Vanilla" at the top. The x-axis appears to represent training steps or iterations, displayed on a linear scale, though the axis labels and tick marks are not clearly visible. The y-axis similarly lacks visible labels and tick marks but appears to represent a loss or similar decreasing metric on a linear scale. Five lines are shown in the legend: "StrmLLM (n=64)" in blue, "SepLLM (n=64)" in orange, "SepLLM (n=64, H)" in green, "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" in red, and "SepLLM (n=128)" in dark purple/navy. All lines begin at high values on the left side of the plot and decrease sharply in the early portion before gradually leveling off toward the right. The blue StrmLLM (n=64) line starts highest and remains consistently above all other lines throughout the entire training process, converging to the highest final value on the right side. The dark purple/navy SepLLM (n=128) line tracks below the blue line but above the remaining three lines for most of the plot. The orange SepLLM (n=64), green SepLLM (n=64, H), and red SepLLM (n=64, H/T) lines cluster together and achieve lower final values, with the red SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line appearing to reach the lowest values at the right end of the plot. All lines exhibit some degree of noise or fluctuation, visible as shaded regions or jitter around each curve, particularly noticeable in the blue and dark purple lines.
